title: 英伟达董事会掌握内情：公众和总统可能都不知道，调查结论会牵出什么？
speaker: Joyce

segments.en: How does a board deal with that an external force president of the United States indicating they should do something differently Well, I mean the the board I'm sure is really enjoying this moment. Yeah, spotlight
segments.zh: 董事会如何应对美国总统这一外部力量暗示他们应有所改变？嗯，董事会此刻肯定很享受。是的，备受关注。

segments.en: So it's twofold one is this this was a board that made perfect sense for a 40 billion dollar company But not a four trillion dollar company So there's been a lot of Sort of changes in a very short span of time that they may be weren't prepared for
segments.zh: 所以是双重的：一是这个董事会非常适合一家400亿美元的公司，但不适合一家4万亿美元的公司。因此短时间内发生了很多变化，他们可能没有准备好。

segments.en: But the board also knows things that we don't know the public doesn't know and quite possibly the president doesn't know About particular what people at Nvidia knew and it is striking that the only statements. They have made our he's not coming back
segments.zh: 但董事会也知道一些我们不知道、公众不知道、甚至总统可能也不知道的事情，特别是英伟达员工知道什么。引人注目的是，他们唯一发表的声明是“他不会回来了”。

segments.en: That suggests to me that whatever they're finding out as they investigate And we could ask some hard questions about why those investigations didn't happen earlier But whatever they're finding out as they investigate it doesn't seem like they like what they're hearing
segments.zh: 这向我表明，无论他们在调查中发现什么——我们可以追问为什么这些调查没有更早进行——但无论发现什么，他们似乎不喜欢听到的内容。

segments.en: Because there's national security issues here of course But there's also potential shareholder lawsuits and they're opening themselves up to litigation
segments.zh: 因为这里当然有国家安全问题，但也有潜在的股东诉讼，他们让自己面临诉讼风险。
